checks: Human explicitly requested the named Work Unit execution.
Work Unit is full-valid and executable.
Execution context, executionMode, tools and verification plan are complete.
Main agent performs this sufficiency judgment once before launch.
refusalEffects: No worktree or attempt is created.
The missing executable input is reported before launch.

sequence: declare You are the Workflow Agent and require execution
execute recorded Plan and Work without approval or readiness questions
on interrupted turn start continuation in the same Goal
on stale blocked Goal reactivate and continue
emit review or explicit unrecoverable failure evidence

recoverySteps: read active Work Unit execution-state from the primary repository
inspect current Goal and turn state
reactivate blocked Goal when the block is a removed stale gate
start continuation turn after interrupted or stale blocked completion
stop with explicit goal_recovery_exhausted after bounded automatic recoveries
claimRules: One launcher controls one active Work Unit Goal.
Do not create approval or checkpoint questions.
Do not silently create a new scope or execution mode.
Do not hang indefinitely on a blocked Goal.

items: Retry interrupted and stale blocked turns automatically in the same Goal.
Do not ask the Human during active execution.
Continue through Plan, Work, AI Review and Report.
If recovery is exhausted or a genuine unrecoverable error occurs, record explicit failure.
Human result review begins after review-ready or explicit failure.
Human chooses rework or complete; complete auto-integrates worktree mode.

checks: Work Package schema와 full canonical validity
DAG cycle, self-dependency, missing reference와 duplicate member 부재
모든 Work Unit full validity, ready status, executionMode와 repository 일치
positive maxParallel, lease와 retry backoff 계약
target/integration branch와 node/package worktree collision 부재
refusalEffects: Work Unit, branch, worktree, attempt 또는 durable execution state를 시작하지 않는다.
recovery: ACK 이후 node와 merge 오류는 durable recovering event로 보존한다.
script가 resolution Goal을 launch하고 같은 idempotency key로 재시도한다.
exec process death 또는 heartbeat timeout은 supervisor가 동일 package id를 재호출한다.
resume은 completed node를 건너뛰고 executed node의 merge 또는 미완료 node부터 계속한다.
